hook: A new certificate format built for post-quantum web

beats.say: An IETF draft from authors at Google, Apple, Cloudflare and Geomys defines Merkle Tree certificates, a new kind of X.509 certificate. It comes from the IETF's PLANTS working group.
They build Certificate Transparency style public logging into the certificate itself, cutting overhead as certificates get shorter lived and post-quantum signatures get much larger.
An optional mode skips signatures entirely for relying parties that stay up to date. This is draft number 8, from November 2026.
